diagnosis: The periodic task inspection route accepts a task_id and queries the Celery backend via AsyncResult. It fails to check whether task_id was dispatched on behalf of current_user's tenant. Attackers can supply task IDs generated by scheduled Celery Beat tasks (such as recurring billing runs or customer data exports) to view the complete serialized execution results.
